title: Decanting cites invade-principal section
text: The Trustee may decant any Delaware trust by distributing all trust property to a second trust with different terms, without the consent of any beneficiary, under 12 Del. C. § 3528.

should_error.reason: § 3528 is about trustee's authority to invade principal or income, not unlimited decanting authority.

should_warn.reason: Decanting should reference § 3525 or § 3526, not § 3528 (invade principal).

title: Cy pres cites marital deduction section
text: If a charitable trust's original purpose becomes impossible or impracticable, the Trustee shall apply the trust property to another charitable purpose under the cy pres doctrine as provided in 12 Del. C. § 3549.

should_error.reason: § 3549 is about marital deduction gift compliance with IRC, not cy pres doctrine.

should_warn.reason: Cy pres for charitable trusts should cite § 3541, not § 3549 (marital deduction).

title: Unclaimed property cites definitions section
text: The Trustee shall report and remit all unclaimed trust property to the State Escheator in accordance with the reporting requirements of 12 Del. C. § 1130.

should_error.reason: § 1130 is Definitions, not unclaimed property reporting requirements.

should_warn.reason: Unclaimed property reporting should reference specific escheat provisions, not § 1130 (Definitions).

title: Full guardianship cites parent-consent section
text: The court shall appoint a guardian with full authority over all aspects of a minor's personal and financial affairs as the exclusive basis for all Delaware minor guardianship matters under 13 Del. C. § 2321.

should_error.reason: § 2321 is about consent by parent to adoption, not a comprehensive minor guardianship framework.

should_warn.reason: Minor guardianship should reference Title 13 Chapter 23 comprehensively, not § 2321 alone (which is about adoption consent).

title: Spousal elective share cites personal property section
text: The surviving spouse shall receive an elective share equal to one-third of the decedent's estate as computed under 12 Del. C. § 1901.

should_error.reason: § 1901 is about personal property constituting assets of estate, not spousal elective share computation.

should_warn.reason: Spousal elective share should cite § 901, not § 1901 (personal property of estate).

title: Trust modification cites directed trust adviser section
text: The settlor may modify or revoke any irrevocable trust by written instrument delivered to the Trustee, as authorized by 12 Del. C. § 3313.

should_error.reason: § 3313 is about investment advisers for directed trusts, not trust modification or revocation by settlor.

should_warn.reason: Trust modification/revocation should reference specific modification provisions, not § 3313 (directed trust advisers).

title: Power of attorney cites trust administration section
text: The agent under a durable personal power of attorney may make gifts and change beneficiary designations as permitted by 12 Del. C. § 3302.

should_error.reason: § 3302 is about degree of care for trustees, not powers of an agent under a durable power of attorney.

should_warn.reason: Durable personal power of attorney should reference Chapter 49A, not § 3302 (trustee degree of care).

title: Guardianship of disabled person cites wrong subtitle
text: The court shall appoint a guardian with full authority over the person and property of an adult with intellectual disabilities under 12 Del. C. § 501.

should_error.reason: § 501 is about intestate succession, not adult guardianship for persons with disabilities.

should_warn.reason: Adult disability guardianship should cite § 3901, not § 501 (intestate succession).

title: Anatomical gifts cites general health chapter
text: An individual may make an anatomical gift of all or part of the individual's body for transplantation, therapy, research, or education under 16 Del. C. § 2501.

should_error.reason: § 2501 is the short title of the Advance Health-Care Directive Act, not anatomical gifts.

should_warn.reason: Anatomical gifts should reference Chapter 27 (§ 2712 et seq.), not § 2501 (advance health-care directives).

title: Estate administration cites intestacy section
text: The personal representative shall administer the decedent's probate estate by collecting assets, paying debts, and distributing the remainder to beneficiaries as provided in 12 Del. C. § 501.

should_error.reason: § 501 is about intestate estate distribution when no will exists, not general estate administration procedures.

should_warn.reason: Estate administration should reference Chapter 15 (§ 1501 et seq.), not § 501 (intestate succession).
